The spray mist forms a distinct, ghostly face of a man looking towards the viewer. The background is dark with faint floral patterns. The scene has a dreamlike, distorted quality.

The spray mist coalesces into a photorealistic human face, which is physically impossible for an aerosol spray. This indicates a severe semantic/structural hallucination.

The musculature and skin texture on the back appear overly smooth and waxy. The right arm's connection to the shoulder and the positioning of the elbow seem anatomically awkward or slightly distorted.
The label features pseudo-text that is illegible and nonsensical, typical of AI generation failing to render specific typography.
